name: XLA_AE_HEADER_ACS
description: This table contains the supporting references segment values for a journal entry header.

columns.name: AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a subledger journal entry at the header level.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the Supporting Reference is seeded or not.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AC1
columns.description: First segment name of a supporting reference.

columns.name: AC2
columns.description: Second segment name of a supporting reference.

columns.name: AC3
columns.description: Third segment name of a supporting reference.

columns.name: AC4
columns.description: Fourth segment name of a supporting reference.

columns.name: AC5
columns.description: Fifth segment name of a supporting reference.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
